headline.title: Anthropic cuts off Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access following government order
headline.summary: Anthropic has complied with a government order to block access to its AI models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5, for all foreign nations due to national security concerns. This decision affects all customers, including Anthropic employees.

articles.title: SFT Drives Gemini’s Safety Properties
articles.summary: Research from Google DeepMind's Language Model Interpretability team reveals that the safety properties of the Gemini model are primarily influenced by the combination of pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT), rather than reinforcement learning. The findings suggest that these safety characteristics may not be universally applicable to other model families.

articles.title: Amazon CEO reportedly raised Anthropic model concerns before government crackdown
articles.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy reportedly raised security concerns regarding Anthropic's models, prompting the company to restrict global access to two of its AI models. This action comes amid ongoing scrutiny and potential government regulation of AI technologies.

articles.title: My yard is dying, so I made an app for that
articles.summary: A developer created an app to address issues in their yard after experiencing problems with their plants. The app, built using Gemini, generated a functional preview but also encountered a bug that could be fixed with a provided button.

articles.title: Apple’s new AI photo editing tools mostly work, for better and worse
articles.summary: Apple has introduced new AI photo editing tools in iOS 27, marking a significant update for its camera features. While these tools offer improved editing capabilities, they are considered less advanced compared to similar features available on Google's Pixel phones.

articles.title: The future of Hollywood isn’t feeding prompts into vanilla gen AI models
articles.summary: Despite the buzz surrounding generative AI's potential in filmmaking, there have been no significant projects that resonate with audiences as viable entertainment options. Current AI video models remain limited, primarily producing short clips rather than full-length, engaging films.

articles.title: OpenAI faces investigation from state attorneys general
articles.summary: OpenAI is under investigation by state attorneys general regarding various aspects of its operations, including advertising practices and the management of health data. The specific states involved in the investigation have not been disclosed.

articles.title: Anthropic Says It’s Taking Claude Fable 5 Offline to Comply With US Government Order
articles.summary: Anthropic announced it is taking its AI model, Claude Fable 5, offline in response to a US government order due to concerns about potential vulnerabilities that could allow users to bypass its safeguards. The company cited the government's awareness of a method for "jailbreaking" the model as the reason for this action.

articles.title: Anthropic’s safety warnings may have just backfired — the government has pulled the plug on its most powerful AI
articles.summary: Anthropic has expressed frustration after the government decided to suspend its most powerful AI model due to concerns over a potential jailbreak vulnerability. The company argues that the finding should not warrant the recall of a widely deployed commercial model.

articles.title: A Court Has Ruled That Google Is Liable for False Statements Generated by AI Overviews
articles.summary: A court has determined that Google is liable for false statements produced by its AI-generated overviews, establishing that companies responsible for AI systems must bear legal responsibility for the content they generate. This ruling sets a precedent for accountability in the use of artificial intelligence technologies.

articles.title: PeopleSoft 0-day affecting hundreds of organizations steals gigabytes of data
articles.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability in Oracle's PeopleSoft software has been identified, affecting hundreds of organizations and resulting in the theft of gigabytes of data. Security experts are urging immediate action to mitigate the risks associated with this exploit.

articles.title: SpaceX IPO: Live updates on everything you need to know
articles.summary: TechCrunch provides comprehensive coverage of SpaceX's upcoming IPO, detailing its history, pre-IPO deals, and insights from its S-1 registration document. The article outlines potential winners and losers in the IPO process as the company prepares for this significant financial milestone.
